author: chinesechessoutloud
title: Lunps28 wins LiXiangQi’s first tournament
intro: Three wins in three games put Lunps28 two points ahead of the organizer, franzbutykoff, in the amistad Arena.

image.alt: amistad Arena final standings. Gold goes to Lunps28 with six points, silver to franzbutykoff with four, and bronze to DanielCallabieto with two.

markdown:
Six players signed up for the amistad Arena on November 5, 2026. The organizer, [franzbutykoff](https://lixiangqi.com/@/franzbutykoff), chose the Spanish word for friendship. [Lunps28](https://lixiangqi.com/@/Lunps28) greeted the room in Portuguese with “Boa sorte a todos” (“Good luck, everyone”).


Each side started with five minutes and gained five seconds per move. In 45 minutes the players finished seven games, four wins for Red and three for Black. Three wins gave [Lunps28](https://lixiangqi.com/@/Lunps28) six points. The organizer took second with four. [DanielCallabieto](https://lixiangqi.com/@/DanielCallabieto) and [ChineseChessOutLoud](https://lixiangqi.com/@/ChineseChessOutLoud) both scored two points, placing third and fourth respectively. [See the final standings.](https://lixiangqi.com/tournament/V7txHyyp)


Against [franzbutykoff](https://lixiangqi.com/@/franzbutykoff), [Lunps28](https://lixiangqi.com/@/Lunps28) lined up both red chariots on the second file. On move 12 the front chariot took the horse on Black’s back rank. Black recaptured with a chariot, and the second red chariot came up the same file to take it. [Replay the exchange from move 12.](https://lixiangqi.com/3TC1Xo15/white#22)

## Start your own tournament

Sign in, open [Tournaments](https://lixiangqi.com/tournament), and choose [Create a new tournament](https://lixiangqi.com/tournament/new). Give the event a name and set how long it will run. Under Games, choose how much time each player starts with and how many seconds each move adds. Under Start date, choose a delay or enter a date and time in your own time zone.


For a private club night, set a tournament entry code under Entry conditions. Once you create the event, share its link and the code with your players. For an open event, the link alone is enough. Players select Join on the tournament page and return to the lobby after each game for their next pairing.


The player with the most points when the tournament clock runs out wins the arena. Tournament games are casual, so the standings are separate from each player’s xiangqi rank.

## Between tournaments

If you have time for one game, you can [challenge a friend or play the computer](https://lixiangqi.com/). To study a game afterward, open its replay, step back to a position you want to revisit, and try a different move. The [analysis board](https://lixiangqi.com/analysis) keeps that variation alongside the game, and you can turn on Pikafish to compare the lines.


To practice finishing an attack with two chariots, try the [Double Chariots Checkmate puzzles (双车错)](https://lixiangqi.com/training/doubleChariotsMate). One chariot cuts off the general’s escape while the other gives check.
